Inclusion Criteria:
Health Coaches Group:
(i) age between 18 and 80 years (ii) fluent in English (iii) work in or carry expertise in physical activity, [OR]  nutrition/ [OR] diet  [OR] or health behavior

People with Diabetes Group (Patient/Caregiver Dyads):
(i) age between 18 and 80 years (ii) fluent in English (iii) have Type-II diabetes
